中州
圣族林家
“你知道我这16年是怎么过的吗？”
巨大而气派的林家族地中，一座豪华的大殿内，一位长相无比帅气，且气质不凡的白袍少年，正神情激动的大喊着。
但大殿内除了他外，却是再无一人……
少年名叫林轩，乃是中州天龙帝朝赫赫有名的圣族林家的少主，身份尊贵无比。
可谓是出生即巅峰！
一出生，便是中域无数修士，一辈子都无法到达的终点！
而他还有一个只有他自己知道的最大的秘密，那便是……
他其实是个穿越者！
和他前世小说中那些魂穿然后，直接夺取原修士的身体的穿越者不同，他乃是正儿八经的十年怀胎所生！
在知道这是个玄幻世界后，原本前世就了无牵挂的林轩，本来还有点激动，幻想自也能如那些主角一般，一路所向披靡，镇压天下！
可是足足过了16年他发现，他并没有那些主角的命……
既没有金手指，也没有老爷爷，更没有系统。
只是个平凡的圣族少主……
（这林狗真特么能装！各位大大，想揍他怎么办？）
虽然他出生在圣族林家这样的强大家族，且还是少主，自身天赋在中州也是最顶尖的那一小撮。
但前世作为资深小说看官，他知道如果不能站在巅峰，总有一天你连死都不知道怎么死！
因为，可能哪天那些超出他认知的大能强者随便一个大战，飞来一个战斗余波，就将他和他林家给灭了，而他可不想再死一次！
所以他这些年，一直在努力修炼，以及寻找属于自己的“挂”。
虽然修为实力已经冠绝林家年轻一辈，但他的“挂”却一直未曾发现……
而就在他准备认命，不再幻想自己有主角的命时，一道突如其来的声音，在他脑海中响起……
“叮，检测到准备摆烂的蓝星意识，族运系统激活绑定中……”
在听到这道声音的第一时间，原本准备摆烂的林轩瞳孔瞬间放大，接着激动不已。
于是，便有了刚才那一幕。
“叮，族运系统绑定成功！”
“哈哈哈，从此咱也是有挂的人了！”
大笑一声后，林轩立马满怀期待的询问道：
“统子，你有啥功能？”
“叮，本系统功能如下，宿主请自行查看……”
旋即，一道只有林轩可见的虚幻光屏，出现在了他眼前！
【族运系统】
【宿主：林轩】
【绑定家族：中州圣族林家】
【系统功能：族运签到、族运抽奖、族运商城、族运之眼】
【族运签到：宿主每日可进行一次日签；每月可进行一次月签；每年可进行一次年签；奖励丰厚程度，依次递增。（签到次数可累积，签到奖励随机，但总体根据家族气运而定。）】
【族运抽奖：宿主可使用一定数量的族运点来进行抽奖，具体规则……展开】
（族运点可通过家族每日固定产生、系统奖励、族人修为突破、家族进阶等途径获得。其中家族等阶越高，每日固定产生的族运点越多；族人修为越高，突破获得的族运点越多。）

Zhongzhou
Holy Clan Lin Family
"16 years!"
"A whole 16 years!"
"Do you know how I spent these 16 years?"
In a luxurious hall in the huge and imposing Lin family, an extremely handsome young man in white robes with extraordinary temperament was shouting excitedly.
But except for him, there was no one else in the hall...
The young man's name is Lin Xuan. He is the young master of the Lin family, a famous holy clan in the Tianlong Emperor Dynasty in Zhongzhou. His status is extremely noble.
It can be said that he is at his peak right from birth!
As soon as he was born, he was the destination that countless monks in the Central Region could not reach in their lifetime!
And he also has the biggest secret that only he knows, and that is...
He is actually a time traveler!
Unlike those time-travelers in his previous life novels who traveled through their souls and directly took the body of the original monk, he was born after a serious ten-year pregnancy!
After knowing that this is a fantasy world, Lin Xuan, who had no worries in his previous life, was a little excited at first. He imagined that he could be like the protagonists, invincible and suppress the world!
But after 16 years, he discovered that he did not have the fate of those protagonists...
There is no golden finger, no grandpa, and no system.
Just an ordinary young master of the holy clan...
(This forest dog is really good at pretending! Guys, what should I do if I want to beat him?)
Although he was born into a powerful family like the Lin family of the Saint Clan, and was still the young master, his own talent was among the top in Zhongzhou.
But as a senior novel reader in his previous life, he knew that if you couldn't stand at the top, one day you wouldn't even know how to die!
Because, maybe one day those powerful men who were beyond his knowledge would have a random battle and the aftermath of the battle would wipe him and the Lin family out, and he didn't want to die again!
So over the years, he has been working hard to practice and find his own "hang".
Although his cultivation strength has surpassed the younger generation of the Lin family, his "hook" has never been discovered...
And just when he was about to accept his fate and no longer imagine that he had the fate of the protagonist, a sudden voice sounded in his mind...
"Ding, the Blue Star Consciousness that is ready to be destroyed has been detected, and the family luck system is being activated and bound..."
The first time he heard this voice, Lin Xuan's pupils, which were about to show off, instantly dilated, and then he became excited.
So, the scene just happened.
"Ding, the clan luck system has been successfully bound!"
"Hahaha, from now on we are also the ones who have trouble!"
After laughing loudly, Lin Xuan immediately asked expectantly:
"Tongzi, what is your function?"
"Ding, the functions of this system are as follows, the host please check it yourself..."
Immediately, an illusory light screen that only Lin Xuan could see appeared in front of him!
【Family Luck System】
[Host: Lin Xuan]
[Bound family: Zhongzhou Saint Clan Lin Family]
[System functions: Clan Luck Sign-in, Clan Luck Lottery, Clan Luck Mall, Clan Luck Eye]
[Family luck sign-in: The host can make a daily sign-in once a day; a monthly sign-in can be made once a month; an annual sign-in can be made once a year; the rewards will be richer in order. (The number of sign-ins can be accumulated, and the sign-in rewards are random, but overall it depends on the family’s luck.)]
[Clan Luck Lottery: The host can use a certain number of Clan Luck Points to draw a lottery, the specific rules... expand]
(Family luck points can be obtained through the daily fixed generation of the family, system rewards, breakthroughs in clan cultivation, and family advancement. The higher the level of the family, the more clan luck points are generated daily; the higher the clan's cultivation level, the more clan luck points are obtained through breakthroughs.)
